name: Sheet-Pan Bratwurst with Peppers and Potatoes
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Heat the oven to 425F and get two or three large sheet pans out. Crowding is the enemy of browning, so use more pans than you think you need.
Cut the potatoes into small chunks, slice the onions and red peppers thick, quarter the mushrooms and mince the garlic.
Toss the potatoes with olive oil, dried thyme, salt and black pepper, spread them out, and give them a head start in the oven since they take the longest.
Add the onions, peppers, mushrooms and garlic to the pans and toss everything together with the potatoes.
Lay the bratwurst on top of the vegetables so they roast in the open air and get color on the skin.
Roast until the brats are browned and cooked through and the vegetables have caught at the edges, turning the pans once partway.
Splash the chicken broth onto the hot pans to lift the browned bits, then combine everything with those juices in your big pot.

name: Harvest Sheet-Pan Chicken with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh (Member's Mark): 7.5 lb (3360 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Heat the oven to 425F with racks in the upper and lower thirds, and pull out two large sheet pans.

Peel and cube the sweet potatoes. Toss them with a third of the olive oil, some italian seasoning, the cinnamon, salt and pepper, spread them on one pan, and give them a 15 minute head start in the oven.

While those roast, halve the brussels sprouts, cut the red onion into thick wedges, and core and chop the apples. Toss all three with another third of the oil, more italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Cut the chicken into large chunks and toss with the last of the oil, the minced garlic, the rest of the italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Pull the sweet potato pan, push the potatoes to one side, and add the sprouts, onion and apple. Spread the chicken in a single layer on the second pan so it roasts instead of steams.
Roast both pans 18 to 22 minutes, swapping racks halfway, until the chicken reads 165F and the sprouts are dark and crispy at the leaf edges.
Scrape everything into your big mixing pot, pan juices included, and fold it together so the cinnamon and the sweet potato starch coat the whole thing.

name: Sheet Pan Pork Tenderloin with Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Heat the oven to 425F and mix the salt, black pepper, chili powder, ground cumin, garlic powder and paprika into a rub.
Cut the potatoes into even chunks, toss them with olive oil and part of the rub, and spread them on sheet pans in a single layer. Crowding is what turns roasted potatoes into steamed ones.
Roast the potatoes alone for 20 minutes so they get a head start.
Pat the pork tenderloins dry, coat them in olive oil and the rest of the rub, and push the potatoes aside to make room on the pans.
Roast 15 minutes, then add the green beans tossed in the remaining olive oil and roast about 10 minutes more.
Pull the pans when the tenderloin reaches 145F inside, then rest the meat 10 minutes before slicing so the juices stay in it.

name: Sheet-Pan Sausage Meatballs with Kale and Potatoes
ingredients: Red Pepper Flakes (Great Value): 0.25 tbsp (1 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Heat the oven to 400F and line two or three large sheet pans.

Soak the bread crumbs in the milk for a few minutes, then mix them with the hot Italian sausage, eggs, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, black pepper and red pepper flakes. Mix gently, because packed meatballs turn out dense.
Roll even meatballs and set them on the pans along with the potato chunks tossed in some of the olive oil.
Roast until the meatballs brown and the potatoes go crisp at the corners.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the pans and roast a few more minutes until they blister and split.
Whisk the red wine vinegar, dijon mustard, brown sugar and remaining olive oil into a dressing while the pans are in the oven.
Pull the pans, scatter the torn kale over the hot food so it wilts from the residual heat, pour the dressing over everything, and toss it all together in your big pot.

name: Sichuan Dan Dan Noodles with Pork
ingredients: Chili Crisp (Lao Gan Ma (Laoganma)): 7.75 oz (220 g)
Rice Noodles (Thai Kitchen): 61.75 oz dry (1750 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Whisk the sauce: peanut butter, soy sauce, hoisin, sugar, chicken broth, and about half the chili crisp. It will look thin now, it thickens when it hits the hot noodles.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot and brown the ground pork, breaking it into small crumbles. Season with the five-spice powder, black pepper, and salt, and let it get crispy at the edges.
Add the garlic to the pork and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Cook the rice noodles per the package, drain, and rinse briefly so they do not glue themselves together.
Steam or microwave the broccoli florets until just tender.
Toss the noodles, sauce, and broccoli together in the big pot until coated, then top with the pork, green onions, chopped peanuts, and the rest of the chili crisp.

name: Sloppy Joe Rice Bowls
ingredients: Olive Oil: 2 tsp (beef) + oil for base (20 g)
Apple Cider Vinegar (Great Value): 1 tbsp (30 g)
steps: Brown 5.4 pounds of 93/7 ground beef with the chopped onion and green bell peppers, then drain.
Stir in the tomato sauce, tomato paste, ketchup, dijon, and garlic.
Simmer until the sauce thickens and clings to the meat.
Cook the rice separately so it stays fluffy.
Spoon the sloppy joe beef over the rice in each container.

name: Slow Cooker Apple Cider Pork Bowls
ingredients: Honey Dijon Mustard (Great Value): 1 bottle (60 g)
steps: Cut the pork loin into big chunks and lay them in the slow cooker.
Add the sliced apples and onions right on top.
Stir the honey dijon mustard, onion powder, and garlic powder together, then pour it over everything.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork shreds with a fork.
While that finishes, roast or boil the potatoes until fork tender.
Pull the pork, spoon it over the potatoes, and ladle a little of that cider gravy over the top.

name: Slow Cooker Balsamic Pork Bowls
ingredients: Black Pepper (Great Value): to taste (3 g)
steps: Rub the pork tenderloin with a little olive oil and set it in the slow cooker with the potatoes.
Whisk the balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and chicken broth, then pour it over.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork and potatoes are tender.
Steam the green beans until crisp-tender and set aside.
Shred the pork and stir it back through the balsamic glaze.
Divide the pork, potatoes, and green beans into your containers.

name: Slow Cooker Barbacoa Burrito Bowl
ingredients: Chipotle in Adobo (La Costena): 1 can (105 g)
Seasoned Black Beans (Great Value): 4 cans (910 g)
Fat Free Cheddar (Great Value): 1 bag (196 g)
Apple Cider Vinegar (Great Value): 2 tbsp (60 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot on a kitchen scale and write the number down. You will need it to portion evenly at the end.
Cut the chuck roast into big 3 inch chunks and drop them in the slow cooker.

Add the diced yellow onion, minced garlic, a few finely chopped chipotle peppers with a spoonful of their adobo sauce, the lime juice, cumin, a pinch of salt and pepper, and the beef broth. Stir it all together with tongs.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours, until the beef falls apart when you poke it with a fork.
Lift the beef onto a cutting board and shred it with two forks. Skim the fat off the top of the cooking liquid and pour some of the broth back over the meat so it stays juicy.
Cook your rice per the package. Warm and drain the black beans.
To build the bowls, layer rice on the bottom, then a scoop of barbacoa, then beans, and finish with a sprinkle of fat free cheddar.

name: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3300 g)
BBQ Sauce (Sugar Free) (Sweet Baby Ray's): 1 bottle (500 g)
Sweet Whole Kernel Corn (Great Value): 3 cans (750 g)
steps: Lay the chicken breasts in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Sprinkle the paprika and garlic powder over the top, then pour on the BBQ sauce.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the chicken shreds with a fork.
Shred the chicken right in the pot and stir it back through the sauce.
Warm the corn and fold it in, or spoon it over the top.
Serve over cooked white rice and portion into your containers.

name: Slow Cooker BBQ Shredded Beef Bowls
ingredients: Apple Cider Vinegar (Great Value): 1.5 cups (336 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and black pepper into a rub and press it into the chuck roast on all sides.
Sear the roast in the olive oil over high heat until the rub darkens and forms a crust, then move it to the slow cooker.
Pour the beef broth into the bottom of the cooker, cover, and cook on low for 8 hours until the beef shreds under a fork.
While it cooks, whisk the ketchup, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, and a shot of hot sauce together for the barbecue sauce.
Shred the beef and drain off most of the cooking liquid, leaving just enough to keep it moist.
Pour the barbecue sauce over the shredded beef, stir it through, and cook on high 30 more minutes so the sauce tightens onto the meat.
Cook the rice separately and scatter the sliced green onions over the top.

name: Slow Cooker Beef and Noodles
ingredients: Egg Noodles (Great Value wide): 41.5 oz dry (1176 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Season the chuck roast with salt and black pepper and set it in the slow cooker whole.
Add the minced garlic, beef broth, and Worcestershire sauce around the roast.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until the beef comes apart when you press it.
Shred the beef with two forks right in the cooker and leave it in the liquid.
Turn the cooker to high, stir in the dry egg noodles, and add enough hot water to just cover them.
Cover and cook 25 to 35 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the noodles are tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed.
Taste and correct the salt and pepper, then let it sit 10 minutes so the noodles finish soaking up the gravy.

name: Slow Cooker Brown Sugar Sesame Pork Bowls
steps: Rub the pork loin with a little olive oil and set it in the slow cooker with the sliced onion.
Stir together the brown sugar and soy sauce, then pour it over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until fork-tender.
Shred the pork and stir it back through the glaze.
Steam the broccoli florets until just tender.
Serve over cooked white rice, sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds, and pack it up.

name: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken and Rice Bowl
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 6 lb (2495 g)
Ranch Seasoning Mix (Hidden Valley): 1 packet (47 g)
Buffalo Wing Sauce (Frank's RedHot): 1 bottle (240 g)
Fat Free Cheddar (Great Value): 1 bag (196 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot on a kitchen scale and write the number down. You will need it to portion evenly at the end.

Put the chicken breast in the slow cooker, sprinkle on the ranch seasoning, and pour over the buffalo sauce. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or high for 3 to 4, until the chicken pulls apart with a fork.
While that finishes, cook your rice per the package. This is your base and it stretches the whole batch.
Roast or steam the broccoli florets until just tender and still bright green. Do not overcook it or it turns to mush by day three.
Shred the chicken while it is still warm, right in the slow cooker, using two forks. Warm chicken shreds far easier than cold.
Toss the shredded chicken back through its own cooking liquid so every bite stays juicy and coated.
Add the cooked rice, broccoli, and the shredded cheddar to your weighed mixing pot and fold everything together.

name: Slow Cooker Butter Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3000 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): to taste (4 g)
steps: Add the chicken breast, chopped onion, and minced garlic to the crock.
Pour in both cans of tomato sauce and drop in the butter with a drizzle of olive oil.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken, then stir in the milk and Greek yogurt for that creamy finish.
Cook the rice while the sauce warms through.
Spoon the butter chicken over rice and serve.

name: Slow Cooker Carne Asada Rice Bowls
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Stem and seed the ancho chile, cover it with hot water, and soak 20 minutes until soft.
Blend the soaked chile with the lime juice, lemon juice, soy sauce, red wine vinegar, olive oil, garlic, jalapeno, half the cilantro, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Put the steak in the slow cooker, pour the marinade over it, and add the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on low for 7 hours, until the beef shreds under light pressure.
Slice the onion and the bell peppers into strips and stir them in for the last 45 minutes so they soften without disappearing.
Shred the beef in the cooker and let it sit in the juices for 10 minutes so it drinks some back up.
Cook the rice separately, finish with the remaining cilantro, and keep the sour cream cold for serving.

name: Slow Cooker Char Siu Pork Bowls
ingredients: Sesame Oil (generic): 1 tsp dark sesame oil (10 g)
steps: Lay the pork loin in the slow cooker.
Stir together the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, honey, and chicken broth, then pour it over.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork is fall-apart tender.
Shred the pork and stir it back through the glaze.
Steam the broccoli florets until bright green and just tender.
Serve over cooked white rice with the broccoli alongside and pack it up.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Adobo Rice Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3450 g)
Bay Leaves (Great Value): 3 dried bay leaves (3 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): 1 tsp peppercorns (5 g)
steps: Add the chicken, white vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, sliced onion, and garlic to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender and soaked with flavor.
Drop the broccoli florets in for the last 30 minutes so they cook but stay firm.
Shred the chicken in the pot and let it soak up the tangy sauce for a few minutes.
Spoon it over white rice with plenty of that dark, salty-sour sauce.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Cacciatore Pasta
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3300 g)
Traditional Pasta Sauce (Great Value): 2 jars (900 g)
steps: Add the chicken, pasta sauce, sliced mushrooms, chopped bell peppers, onion, olive oil, and garlic to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken shreds and the vegetables are tender.
Shred the chicken into the sauce and stir everything together.
Boil the penne separately until just al dente and drain it.
Toss the pasta with the cacciatore sauce, or spoon the sauce over each portion of pasta.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Chile Verde Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3200 g)
Diced Green Chiles (Old El Paso): 2 cans (200 g)
steps: Husk and quarter the tomatillos, then lay them in the crock with the chicken thighs.
Add the chopped onion and both cans of green chiles.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken pulls apart easily.
Shred the thighs and stir them back into the green sauce.
Cook up your rice and steam the broccoli.
Serve the chile verde over rice with broccoli on the side.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Curry Rice Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3100 g)
steps: Add the chicken breast, chopped onion, sliced carrots, and minced garlic to the crock.
Stir in the curry powder and pour in the chicken broth.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken, then stir in the Greek yogurt for creaminess.
Whisk the cornstarch with a little water and stir it in to thicken the sauce.
Serve the curry over rice.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Gyro Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3450 g)
steps: Add the chicken, olive oil, sliced onion, and garlic to the slow cooker and stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender and shreddable.
Stir the Greek yogurt and lime juice together for a quick tzatziki-style sauce and chill it.
Steam or roast the broccoli florets to round out the bowl.
Shred the chicken over white rice with the broccoli, then finish with the yogurt sauce.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Korma Rice Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3100 g)
steps: Add the chicken breast, chopped onion, and minced garlic to the crock.
Stir in the tomato paste, coconut milk, chicken broth, and a spoonful of honey.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken and stir it back into the creamy sauce.
Blend or crush the cashews and stir them in to thicken and enrich.
Serve the korma over rice.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Pozole Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3200 g)
Enchilada Sauce (Old El Paso): 2 cans (300 g)
Dried Oregano (Great Value): 1 tbsp Mexican oregano (6 g)
steps: Place the chicken breast in the crock with the chopped onion.
Pour in both cans of enchilada sauce and a drizzle of olive oil.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken, then stir in the drained hominy and let it heat through.
Shred the cabbage while the pot warms up.
Ladle into bowls and top each with a handful of crisp cabbage.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Saag Rice Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3200 g)
steps: Add the chicken breast and minced garlic to the crock.
Pour in the tomato sauce and coconut milk.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken and stir in the thawed chopped spinach.
Let everything heat through for another 20 minutes.
Serve the saag over rice.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Shawarma Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3450 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): to taste (4 g)
steps: Add the chicken, olive oil, chicken broth, and garlic to the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender and pulls apart easily.
Whisk the Greek yogurt, tahini, and lime juice together to make the drizzle sauce and set it aside.
Steam or roast the broccoli florets while the chicken finishes.
Shred the chicken, pile it over white rice with the broccoli, and spoon the yogurt-tahini sauce on top.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Rice Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3100 g)
Cheddar Cheese, Shredded (Great Value): 1 bag (112 g)
steps: Lay the chicken breast in the bottom of the crock.
Scatter the chopped onion over the top, then pour both jars of salsa over everything.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, until the chicken shreds with a fork.
Shred the chicken right in the pot and stir it back into the salsa.
Steam the broccoli and cook up your rice.
Build bowls with rice, taco chicken, a handful of broccoli, and a sprinkle of cheddar.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tagine Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3450 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): to taste (4 g)
steps: Add the chicken, drained chickpeas, diced tomatoes, chopped onion, sliced carrots, olive oil, broth, garlic, and lime juice to the slow cooker.
Stir everything together so the spices and liquid coat the chicken and vegetables.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken shreds and the carrots are tender.
Shred the chicken into the stew and let it simmer together for a few minutes.
Spoon the tagine over white rice with plenty of the tomatoey broth.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala Rice Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3100 g)
steps: Add the chicken breast to the crock with both cans of diced tomatoes.
Pour in both cans of coconut milk.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken and stir it back through the creamy sauce.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Serve over rice with broccoli on the side.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tinga Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3100 g)
Chipotle in Adobo (La Costena): 1 can (90 g)
Cheddar Cheese, Shredded (Great Value): 1 bag (112 g)
steps: Set the chicken breast in the crock.
Add the chopped onion, both cans of diced tomatoes, and the chipotle in adobo.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until fork tender.
Shred the chicken and stir it back through the smoky sauce.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Fill bowls with rice, tinga chicken, broccoli, and a little cheddar on top.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3000 g)
Seasoned Black Beans (Great Value): 2 cans (500 g)
Sweet Whole Kernel Corn (Great Value): 2 cans (400 g)
Cheddar Cheese, Shredded (Great Value): 1 bag (112 g)
Enchilada Sauce (Old El Paso): 10 oz can (570 g)
Diced Green Chiles (Old El Paso): 4.5 oz can (255 g)
Lime Juice: juice of 1 lime (60 g)
steps: Add the chicken breast and the can of crushed tomatoes to the crock.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken, then stir in the black beans and corn.
Let it heat through for another 15 to 20 minutes.
Cook your rice while the pot finishes.
Spoon over rice and finish each bowl with a little cheddar.

name: Slow Cooker Cilantro Lime Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3200 g)
steps: Put the chicken breast in the crock.
Drizzle with olive oil, honey, and a good pour of lime juice.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken and toss it back through the tangy juices.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Build bowls with rice, cilantro lime chicken, and broccoli.

name: Slow Cooker BBQ Country Style Pork Ribs over Rice
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cut the pork shoulder into thick rib style strips and pat them dry so the rub sticks.
Stir the garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt and black pepper together and rub it over every surface of the pork.
Slice the yellow onions and spread them across the bottom of the slow cooker to make a bed the meat can sit on.
Lay the pork on the onions, sprinkle the brown sugar over the top, and pour about half the barbecue sauce across everything.
Cover and cook on low until the meat pulls apart with light pressure from a fork.
Cook the rice near the end so it is fresh and hot when the pork is done.
Shred the pork right in the cooker, stir in the rest of the barbecue sauce and the juices, then combine with the rice in your big pot.

name: Slow Cooker Crack Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3450 g)
1/3 Fat Cream Cheese (Great Value): 1 block (140 g)
Cheddar Cheese, Shredded (Great Value): 1 bag (170 g)
Ranch Seasoning Mix (Hidden Valley): 1 packet (45 g)
Hickory Smoked Bacon (Great Value): 1 package (60 g)
steps: Add the chicken, cream cheese, ranch seasoning, and chicken broth to the slow cooker.
Nestle the cut potatoes around the chicken so they cook in the creamy broth.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the potatoes are tender and the chicken shreds.
Cook and crumble the bacon while everything finishes.
Shred the chicken, stir in the shredded cheddar until melted, then top with the crumbled bacon and serve.

name: Slow Cooker Creamy Chicken and Mushroom Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3300 g)
1/3 Fat Cream Cheese (Great Value): 1 block (168 g)
steps: Add the chicken, sliced mushrooms, chicken broth, cream cheese, and garlic powder to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender and the mushrooms are soft.
Shred the chicken and stir everything so the cream cheese melts into a smooth sauce.
Stir in the Greek yogurt off the heat to keep the sauce creamy and tangy.
Spoon the creamy chicken and mushrooms over white rice.

name: Slow Cooker Cuban Mojo Pork Bowls
ingredients: Seasoned Black Beans (Great Value): 3 cans (1200 g)
steps: Place the pork tenderloin in the slow cooker.
Pour the orange juice and lime juice over the pork, then add the garlic and cumin.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until fork-tender.
Shred the pork and stir it back through the citrus juices.
Warm the seasoned black beans and spoon them into your bowls as the base.
Top the beans with the mojo pork and divide into containers.

name: Slow Cooker Dr Pepper Pulled Pork Bowls
ingredients: BBQ Sauce (Sugar Free) (Sweet Baby Ray's): 1 bottle (360 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): for rub (3 g)
steps: Set the pork loin in the slow cooker and scatter the sliced onion around it.
Pour the zero-sugar soda over the pork until it is about halfway up the sides.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork shreds easily.
Drain off most of the liquid, then shred the pork right in the pot.
Stir in the BBQ sauce and let it warm through for a few minutes.
Serve over cooked potatoes and divide into containers.

name: Slow Cooker Filipino Pork Adobo Bowls
ingredients: Bay Leaves (Great Value): 3 dried bay leaves (3 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): 6 ground peppercorns (3 g)
steps: Add the pork loin, sliced onion, and garlic to the slow cooker.
Pour in the soy sauce and white vinegar and give it a stir.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork is tender.
Shred or chunk the pork and stir it back into the tangy sauce.
Steam the green beans until just tender and cook the rice.
Spoon the pork over rice and serve the green beans alongside.

name: Slow Cooker French Onion Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3450 g)
Condensed French Onion Soup: 2 cans (10.5 oz each) (600 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): to taste (3 g)
steps: Add the chicken, sliced onions, beef broth, and garlic powder to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours so the onions go soft, sweet, and jammy.
Shred the chicken into the pot and stir so it soaks up the broth.
Stir in the Greek yogurt off the heat for a creamy, tangy finish.
Serve over white rice and top each bowl with grated parmesan.

name: Slow Cooker Greek Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 8 lb (3450 g)
steps: Add the chicken, olive oil, lime juice, red wine vinegar, and garlic to the slow cooker and toss to coat.
Nestle the cut potatoes around and under the chicken so they cook in the juices.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the potatoes are fork-tender and the chicken shreds.
Shred the chicken and stir everything together so the potatoes catch the tangy sauce.
Serve the chicken and potatoes together, spooning the pan juices over the top.

name: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Pork Bowls
ingredients: Red Pepper Flakes (Great Value): 1/2 tsp (2 g)
steps: Place the pork loin in the slow cooker.
Whisk together the honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic, then pour it over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the meat shreds easily.
Steam the broccoli florets in the last few minutes so they stay bright and crisp.
Cook the rice while the pork rests.
Shred the pork, pile it over rice, add the broccoli, and drizzle the pan sauce on top.

name: Slow Cooker Honey Sesame Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3100 g)
steps: Add the chicken breast and minced garlic to the crock.
Pour in the soy sauce, ketchup, honey, and a splash of sesame oil.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken, then whisk the cornstarch with a little water and stir it in to thicken the glaze.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Serve the honey sesame chicken over rice with broccoli.

name: Slow Cooker Italian Beef Rice Bowl
ingredients: Seasoned Black Beans (Great Value): 2 cans (455 g)
Reduced Fat Mozzarella (Great Value): 1 bag (196 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot on a kitchen scale and write the number down. You will need it to portion evenly at the end.
Cut the chuck roast into large chunks, season with a little salt and pepper, and place them in the slow cooker.
Pour in the whole jar of pepperoncini along with its juice, add the beef broth, sliced yellow onion, minced garlic, and Italian seasoning. Give it a stir.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, until the beef shreds easily with a fork.
Shred the beef right in the pot with two forks and stir it back through that tangy pepper broth so every bite soaks up the flavor.
Cook your rice per the package, warm and drain the black beans, and slice the green bell peppers to stir in during the last stretch of cooking.
Build each bowl with rice on the bottom, a scoop of the beef and peppers, beans, and a little reduced fat mozzarella on top so it melts into the warm meat.

name: Slow Cooker Italian Chicken Penne
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 6 lb (2495 g)
Red Pepper Flakes (Great Value): 1/4 tsp (2 g)
steps: Weigh your empty mixing pot on a kitchen scale and write the number down. You will need it to portion evenly at the end.
Lay the chicken breast in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Pour the chicken broth and coconut milk over the top, then add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, garlic powder, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours, until the chicken pulls apart easily.
Shred the chicken right in the pot with two forks and stir it back into all that sauce.
Boil the protein penne until just tender, drain, and add it to your empty weighed mixing pot.
Tip the shredded chicken and sauce over the pasta, add the grated parmesan, and stir until everything is coated and glossy.

name: Slow Cooker Italian Pork and White Bean Bowls
ingredients: Reduced Fat Mozzarella (Great Value): 1 bag (150 g)
steps: Rub the pork loin with a little olive oil and set it in the slow cooker.
Add the diced tomatoes, chopped onion, and sliced red bell pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork is tender.
Shred the pork and stir in the drained cannellini beans.
Cook another 15 to 20 minutes to warm the beans through.
Spoon into bowls, top with the shredded mozzarella, and let it melt before packing up.

name: Slow Cooker Jerk Pork Bowls
ingredients: Chicken Broth (Swanson): 1/2-1 cup low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth (240 g)
steps: Cut the pork loin into large pieces and add them to the slow cooker.
Toss in the sliced onions and your jerk seasoning, rubbing it into the meat a bit.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork pulls apart easily.
Steam the broccoli florets just until tender toward the end.
Cook the rice so it is hot and ready.
Shred the pork, spoon it over the rice, and serve the broccoli alongside.

name: Slow Cooker Kalua Pork Bowls
steps: Set the pork loin in the slow cooker and season it well with salt.
Add a splash of water, cover, and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours until it falls apart.
Shred the pork right in the pot and stir it through the juices.
Pile the chopped cabbage on top of the pork.
Cover and cook another 30 to 45 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Serve the pork and cabbage over cooked white rice and portion out.

name: Slow Cooker King Ranch Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 7 lb (3100 g)
Cheddar Cheese, Shredded (Great Value): 2 bags (280 g)
Corn Tortillas: 15 corn tortillas, torn (450 g)
Black Pepper (Great Value): to taste (4 g)
steps: Set the chicken breast in the crock with the can of diced tomatoes.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken and stir it back into the sauce.
Stir in most of the cheddar and let it melt through.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Build bowls with rice, king ranch chicken, broccoli, and the last of the cheese on top.

name: Slow Cooker Korean Gochujang Pork Bowls
steps: Set the pork loin in the slow cooker.
Whisk the gochujang, soy sauce, honey, and chicken broth, then pour it over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork shreds easily.
Shred the pork and stir it back into the sauce.
Steam the broccoli florets until just tender and set aside.
Serve the pork and broccoli over cooked white rice and portion out.

name: Slow Cooker Korean Shredded Pork Bowls
steps: Add the pork tenderloin, sliced onion, garlic, and grated ginger to the slow cooker.
Stir the soy sauce and brown sugar together, then pour it over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork shreds easily.
Shred the pork right in the pot so it soaks up the sauce.
Cook the rice and warm the shredded carrots for a fresh crunch.
Pile the pork over rice and top with the carrots.
